name: project-alpha
description: Helper npm scripts for running preprocessing and training tasks

scripts.parquet: python preprocessing/test/describe_parquet.py --input data/preprocessed/fast/20231219.parquet --output preprocessing/test/parquet-output.txt && python preprocessing/test/describe_parquet.py --input data/preprocessed/20231219.parquet --output preprocessing/test/parquet-labels-output.txt
scripts.training: python training/tcn.py --feature-root data/preprocessed --label-root data/preprocessed --resolutions fast mid slow --feature-set phase5 --targets t20 t40 t60 t100 --target-loss-weights 1 1 1 1 --class-weight-power 0.5 --sequence-len 64 --batch-size 128 --epochs 15
